question: What forms of beauty, benevolence, and primordial origin are attributed to the supreme being?
premises: The being has a beautiful form and is good-minded Soma.
The being is born at the beginning of the world.
inference: The supreme being manifests as beautiful, benevolent, identified with Govinda, and primordial in origin.
plain_english: He is of beautiful form, good-minded Soma, Govinda, and born at the beginning of the world.
